away.text: TB is in heavy personnel (2+ TE or 2+ RB) on 15% of plays (league 42%); DAL plays a light box on 47% of snaps (league 43%), a stacked box on 19% (league 25%), and nickel/dime on 65% (league 68%). Against TB's personnel, expect 41% light and 21% stacked boxes -> TB run efficiency +0.4%. Targets: tight ends +6.0%, backs +2.3% (receivers give up the difference), because DAL is in base personnel more than usual against TB's 3-WR looks, so linebackers cover backs and tight ends more often; and heavy personnel against nickel/dime, which puts a defensive back on the tight end, should come up less than usual in this game. Slot: Emeka Egbuka (39% slot) targets +1.1%, Chris Godwin Jr. (37% slot) targets +1.0%, Kameron Johnson (32% slot) targets +0.9%.

home.text: DAL is in heavy personnel (2+ TE or 2+ RB) on 30% of plays (league 42%); TB plays a light box on 30% of snaps (league 43%), a stacked box on 30% (league 25%), and nickel/dime on 65% (league 68%). Against DAL's personnel, expect 35% light and 26% stacked boxes -> DAL run efficiency −1.3%. Targets: tight ends +2.9%, backs +1.2% (receivers give up the difference), because TB is in base personnel more than usual against DAL's 3-WR looks, so linebackers cover backs and tight ends more often; and heavy personnel against nickel/dime, which puts a defensive back on the tight end, should come up less than usual in this game. Slot: Ryan Flournoy (32% slot) targets +0.4%, CeeDee Lamb (27% slot) targets +0.4%, George Pickens (19% slot) targets +0.3%.
